services.name: Benefits of Long-term RV Parks
services.desc: One of the most obvious advantages of a monthly reservation is the cost. Campgrounds typically offer reduced rates for extended stays, and the savings can be substantial when compared to daily or weekly fees. Example: If a campground charges $75 per night, a week costs $525. However, a monthly rate is $650-$800/mo with utilities and Wi-Fi included. That’s a 40% discount over nightly rates. When you reserve nightly or weekly, you may find yourself packing up and moving frequently, even when you'd rather stay put. services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Located between the Astoria Bridge and Ilwaco, in the cozy little town of Chinook, WA, Columbia Shores is a quaint RV campground in a park-like setting fully equipped with 57 sites. This Long Beach campground is a fisherman's dream, with sturgeon and salmon all within casting distance. However, the area offers more than some of Washington's best sport fishing. Nearby Long Beach hosts one of the largest kite festivals in the world, boasts the longest beach in the United States (28 miles of sand), and offers great restaurants.
